highlight.js 11.12.0
https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js/releases/tag/11.12.0
https://highlightjs.org/

highlight-11.12.0.min.js is es/highlight.min.js from the published npm package
@highlightjs/cdn-assets@11.12.0: the core with its common languages. languages/
holds that package's es/languages grammars for languages the common set leaves
out; Chat loads one only when a code block names it. The only changes are the
renamed core file and removed sourceMappingURL comments. Colors come from
Chat's own stylesheet, not a highlight.js theme.
No CDN requests or npm install are required by Obleth Chat at build/runtime.

Upstream tarball:
https://registry.npmjs.org/@highlightjs/cdn-assets/-/cdn-assets-11.12.0.tgz
SHA-512 integrity:
sha512-KvOKXODaiFmId9xaq3xc5xCL66wVLUuOngDbO9B/kewbFTqdGbn2nJxNhN3H5R1cgDTVj6R8vH0zgiNDEGjpDw==

highlight.js is BSD-3-Clause licensed; see LICENSE. It has no bundled
dependencies.

Update by downloading a reviewed tagged npm release with npm pack
--ignore-scripts, verifying the registry integrity, and replacing these files
and the license. Run tests/markdown.test.mjs after updates.
